items.text: Sections and interface markers are schematic; not to scale.

caption: Figure 1. Constructed DEMO mechanism, with schematic geometry. In R, tray-to-wall gaps connect the upper plenum to the lower collector, bypassing both beds despite the lid gasket. In S, each continuous rim gasket seats on a ledge and interrupts that route. Trays are open at the top, with mesh bottoms; the media surface is not a lid. Lid-gasket sections lie only at wall contacts. Flow arrows show available paths, not a measured velocity field or flow split. The stopped, drained service view shows the same empty upper tray above its vacant seat, the lower tray remaining and the lid lifted. Circles mark the chamber guide and that tray's tab; they are interfaces, not actual shapes. Lift and insertion directions are shown; rejection geometry is unspecified.
alt_text: R and S each have two open-top mesh-bottom trays, A above B. Lid-gasket sections lie only at wall contacts. R has a continuous side bypass and S seals each tray rim. The separate stopped, drained service state shows the same empty upper tray above its vacant seat, lift upward and insertion downward, with the lower tray remaining. A circle on the removed tray marks its tab; a circle attached to the chamber wall ledge marks the chamber guide. The circles mark interfaces, not actual mating shapes or a geometrical proof of reversed-insertion rejection.
